name: Stella Pringle

events.title: Marriage
events.description: To Conrad Sipple (1870-1936), county marriage record

bioAdditions: The FamilySearch profile with records is Stella M. Pringle: born 11 Jun 1876 at Larksville, in Andrew's household in 1880, married Conrad Sipple in Luzerne Co. on 24 Dec 1895 (county marriage record attached), living in Larksville until her death there on 17 Mar 1920, and buried at Cedar Crest Cemetery, Trucksville (S1). The other FamilySearch 'Stella' (1874-1893) has no sources and is probably a duplicate. A 'Stella' who died in 1893 would also conflict with Bradsby's 1893 list, which names Estella as living (S2).
